scope: Language-guided exploration of the declared source family, using one retained-instance representative of each duplicate pair. It supplies no independent source witness and is not a probability or proof of decipherment. Words were chosen to inspect a provisions/strength lead; this is not a blind held-out evaluation.
score_description: Sum squared word lengths for nonoverlapping regex matches, longer alternatives first, minus one per question-mark position. Keep the300 greatest(score,single,a,b,raw) tuples.
